question: Could you find out the average percentage of the total lifetime sales (LTV) that occur in the first 7 and 30 days after a customer's initial purchase? Also, include the average total lifetime sales (LTV). Please exclude customers with zero lifetime sales. The 7- and 30-day periods should be based on the exact number of hours-minutes-seconds, not calendar days.
sql:
WITH first_payment AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        MIN(payment_date) AS first_payment_date
    FROM payment
    GROUP BY customer_id
),
customer_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        SUM(amount) AS total_ltv
    FROM payment
    GROUP BY customer_id
),
first_7_days AS (
    SELECT 
        fp.customer_id,
        SUM(p.amount) AS amount_first_7_days
    FROM first_payment fp
    JOIN payment p ON fp.customer_id = p.customer_id
        AND p.payment_date >= fp.first_payment_date
        AND p.payment_date < fp.first_payment_date + INTERVAL '168' HOUR
    GROUP BY fp.customer_id
),
first_30_days AS (
    SELECT 
        fp.customer_id,
        SUM(p.amount) AS amount_first_30_days
    FROM first_payment fp
    JOIN payment p ON fp.customer_id = p.customer_id
        AND p.payment_date >= fp.first_payment_date
        AND p.payment_date < fp.first_payment_date + INTERVAL '720' HOUR
    GROUP BY fp.customer_id
)
SELECT 
    ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN ct.total_ltv > 0 
        THEN 1.0 * COALESCE(f7.amount_first_7_days, 0) / ct.total_ltv * 100 
        ELSE 0 END), 2) AS avg_pct_first_7_days,
    ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN ct.total_ltv > 0 
        THEN 1.0 * COALESCE(f30.amount_first_30_days, 0) / ct.total_ltv * 100 
        ELSE 0 END), 2) AS avg_pct_first_30_days,
    ROUND(AVG(ct.total_ltv), 2) AS avg_total_ltv
FROM customer_totals ct
LEFT JOIN first_7_days f7 ON ct.customer_id = f7.customer_id
LEFT JOIN first_30_days f30 ON ct.customer_id = f30.customer_id
WHERE ct.total_ltv > 0
